instruction: Import the CSV file 'employee_list.csv' from the Downloads folder into Calc, sort the data by last names, and save it as 'Sorted_Employee_List.csv' in the Documents folder.
evaluator: [ -f ~/Documents/Sorted_Employee_List.csv ] && [ -s ~/Documents/Sorted_Employee_List.csv ] && python3 -c "import csv, os, sys; path=os.path.expanduser('~/Documents/Sorted_Employee_List.csv'); f=open(path, 'r'); reader=csv.DictReader(f); rows=list(reader); f.close(); last_names=[row['Last Name'].strip() for row in rows if 'Last Name' in row and row['Last Name']]; is_sorted=all(last_names[i].lower() <= last_names[i+1].lower() for i in range(len(last_names)-1)) if len(last_names) > 1 else False; sys.exit(0 if is_sorted else 1)" && echo True || echo False
